Hymn 42: Hail to the Brightness of Zion's Glad Morning!
Time Signature: 6/8
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: Lowell Mason
Lyricist/Text Author: Thomas Hastings
Category: Praise to the Lord

This is hymn number 42 titled "Hail to the Brightness of Zion's Glad Morning!" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 6/8 time signature. 
The music was composed by Lowell Mason and the lyrics were written by Thomas Hastings.
This hymn is categorized under: Praise to the Lord.
